name: Eau Claire River (Altoona)

blurb: A short urban paddle on the lower Eau Claire River from River Prairie Park in Altoona to Phoenix Park at the Chippewa River confluence. This moving-water trip has rapids and is recommended for experienced kayakers. It is a different river from the Eau Claire tributary near Wausau.

sections.notes: An urban paddle from River Prairie below Altoona Dam to Phoenix Park at the Chippewa River confluence. Visit Eau Claire recommends experienced kayakers because of rapids. Check conditions and the Phoenix shoreline exit before launching, and arrange a vehicle shuttle. This trip ends at Phoenix; continuing toward Hobbs is a separate Chippewa River stretch.
sections.routeReview: The dotted line shows the general river course. Exact shore connections and passages through rapids, bridge openings or obstructions are not mapped.

measurement.reviewNote: Reviewed the complete tourism map and both overlapping halves against satellite imagery on 2026-11-06. The line follows the visible Eau Claire River corridor between the named accesses; it generalizes bars, banks and bridges. It ends near, not at, the shoreline points. Measured approximately 2.7476 miles; no landing connectors or survey accuracy are implied.
